summary: Retrieve artists' geographical locations with optional filtering
description: Returns a list of artists together with their declared geographical location information. Allows filtering by country, city, coordinates and radius, as well as typical Jamendo query parameters such as pagination, ordering and format. The client_id parameter is required for authentication.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with format=json and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (max 200). The special keyword 'all' also caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append _asc or _desc to specify direction; default is ascending except for popularity fields which default to descending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes the total count of results without pagination.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs to filter.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search an artist by name (artist_name matching *searchquery*).

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists with an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter on the artist joining date (format yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd).

parameters.name: haslocation
parameters.description: Return only artists with (true) or without (false) locations.

parameters.name: location_country
parameters.description: Filter by artist country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes.

parameters.name: location_radius
parameters.description: Radius in kilometers around location_coords. Ignored if location_coords is not provided.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request, including status, code, warnings, results_count and optionally results_fullcount.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of artist objects with location information. Each object contains fields such as id, name, website, joindate, image, shorturl, shareurl, location_country, location_city, location_coords, etc.

notes: client_id is mandatory; without it the request will be rejected.
When using the callback parameter, format must be set to json; otherwise the parameter is ignored.
location_radius is only applied when location_coords is supplied; otherwise it is ignored.
The limit parameter caps at 200 even when using the 'all' keyword.
